title: 123 lets go upside down! #strangerthings #broadway @TheArtsInsider
transcript: This just got delivered to my front door from literal stranger things, so we gotta open it. Oh, my god, I have full body chills. What? What does this mean? Broadway! Stranger things on Broadway! What? Paul, are you excited? No way! It literally says, bro, it's upside down. Get it? Cause, like, oh, my god, we're in the Upside Down, Paul, and we're gonna be on Broadway! Stranger things on Broadway! You wanna go to Stranger Things? The First Shadow on Broadway, March 2025, baby! I can't wait to know what it's all about. Oh, I'm already obsessed.
